title: MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI
abstract: arXiv:2611.17199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. Recently, unsupervised representation learning using graph neural networks has unveiled these utilization-specific complex spectral relations. This article has three main contributions. First, it proposes an index, the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI), which measures the similarity between two pixels based on their neighborhood information. The index is used to construct a weighted adjacency matrix, giving the HSI a graph structure. Second, it proposes an upgraded Graph Attention Network that learns compact latent representations of hyperspectral data from the constructed graph. translated_title: 融合MALNISI图构建与基于加权对比损失的图注意力网络用于高光谱图像无监督表示学习
translated_abstract: 高光谱图像（HSI）由于具有高维信息，因而具备针对土地利用类型的判别性光谱特征。近年来，基于图神经网络的无监督表示学习揭示了这些与利用类型相关的复杂光谱关系。本文有三个主要贡献。首先，提出了一种指数——平均绝对局部邻域逆光谱指数（MALNISI），该指数基于邻域信息来度量两个像素之间的相似性。该指数被用于构建加权邻接矩阵，从而赋予高光谱图像一种图结构。其次，提出了一种升级版的图注意力网络，从构建的图中学习高光谱数据的紧凑潜在表示。在该网络中，增强的多头注意力机制将MALNISI权重作为辅助特征加以融合，以强调相邻像素之间的学习注意力。为了缓解……
tldr: 本文提出平均绝对局部邻域逆光谱指数（MALNISI）来度量像素间相似性并构建高光谱图像的加权图结构，进而设计融合MALNISI权重的增强型多头注意力图注意力网络，结合加权对比损失实现高光谱图像的无监督表示学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI) to measure pixel similarity for constructing a weighted graph from hyperspectral images, and develops an enhanced Graph Attention Network with MALNISI-infused multi-head attention and weighted contrastive loss for unsupervised HSI representation learning.
